title: Whole Genome Sequencing of Human Bacterial Pathogens Protocol
author: Sanjay Gautam

steps.title: Pellet liquid culture
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of liquid culture to a sterile micro‑fuge tube and centrifuge for 8 min; treat all cultures as potentially pathogenic and use appropriate PPE and aseptic technique.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet to target OD
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 600 µL phosphate‑buffered saline (1×) and adjust the absorbance at 600 nm (A₆₀₀) to between 1.0 and 2.0.

steps.title: Lyse cells with lysozyme
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL lysozyme (50 mg mL⁻¹), vortex briefly, and incubate at 37 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Extract DNA with DNeasy kit
steps.instruction: Follow the DNeasy® Blood and Tissue Kit Quick‑Start protocol to extract genomic DNA.

steps.title: Elute DNA from kit
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA in 100 µL elution buffer.

steps.title: Purify RNase‑treated DNA
steps.instruction: Using the High Pure PCR Template Preparation Kit, perform only four spin‑wash steps (instead of nine); pre‑heat the elution buffer at 70 °C before use.

steps.title: Add binding buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL binding buffer to the RNase‑treated DNA and incubate at 70 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add isopropanol and bind to column
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL 2‑propanol, transfer the mixture to a Roche spin column, and centrifuge for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash column – first wash
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through, place the spin column in a new collection tube, add 500 µL wash buffer, and centrifuge for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash column – second wash
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through, insert the column into a fresh collection tube, and perform a final spin for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute purified DNA
steps.instruction: Insert the column into a 1.5 mL sterile micro‑fuge tube, add 50 µL pre‑heated elution buffer, and centrifuge for 1 min to obtain DNA suitable for NGS (260/280 = 1.8–2.0).

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Dispense 190 µL Qubit working solution into a standard tube and 198 µL into a sample tube; add 10 µL each of standards 1 and 2 to the standard tube and 2 µL of DNA sample to the sample tube; vortex 3 s, incubate at room temperature for 2 min, then read fluorescence.

steps.title: Normalize DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute each DNA sample with distilled water to achieve a final concentration of 0.2 ng µL⁻¹ (accurate concentration is critical for library preparation).

steps.title: Tagmentation reaction
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine 5 µL tagmentation DNA buffer, 2.5 µL amplification tagmentation mix, and 2.5 µL (0.2 ng µL⁻¹) input DNA.

steps.title: Neutralize tagmentation
steps.instruction: Immediately after the reaction reaches the hold temperature of 10 °C, add 2.5 µL neutralization tagmentation buffer and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 µL Nextera® PCR Mastermix and 2.5 µL each of index primers 1 and 2 (avoid primer combinations S502 with N705/706, S503 with N701/702, and any repeated combinations); gently pipette, quick‑spin, and run the PCR.

steps.title: AMPure XP bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Bring AMPure XP beads to room temperature for 20 min; add 11.25 µL beads to 22.5 µL PCR product, pipette 10 times, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on magnetic stand 2 min, aspirate supernatant without disturbing beads, add 100 µL 80 % ethanol twice (each 30 s), air‑dry 5 min (avoid over‑drying), add 26.15 µL resuspension buffer, pipette 20 times, incubate 2 min, magnetic stand 2 min, transfer 25 µL cleared supernatant to a new tube (store at –15 °C to –20 °C up to 1 week, but proceed to library normalization immediately).

steps.title: Quantify cleaned library
steps.instruction: Perform the Qubit DNA quantification method as described earlier to determine the concentration of the bead‑purified library.

steps.title: Pool libraries
steps.instruction: Pool all libraries; use the sample with the lowest concentration as a 10 µL reference and calculate each volume with V₂ = (S₁ × V₁)/S₂.

steps.title: NaOH treatment of pool
steps.instruction: Add freshly prepared 0.2 M NaOH to the pooled library to reach a final concentration of 0.1 M and incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add LNS1 normalization buffer
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (2 × the NaOH‑treated volume) of LNS1 (Library Normalisation Storage Buffer 1); label the tube as pooled amplified library (PAL).

steps.title: Dilute PAL 1:1000
steps.instruction: Dilute PAL 1:1000 by mixing 1 µL PAL with 999 µL ultrapure distilled water.

steps.title: KAPA library qPCR quantification
steps.instruction: Set up a KAPA library quantification kit (No ROX) qPCR run with six DNA standards (20 pM to 0.0002 pM), three no‑template controls, and three replicates of the diluted library; run on a real‑time PCR system.

steps.title: Calculate original library concentration
steps.instruction: Determine library concentration from the standard curve (pM) and calculate the original concentration using: (average pM × 452 bp × dilution factor ÷ 500 bp). Example: (2.36 pM × 452 × 1000)/500 = 2133.44 pM.

steps.title: Prepare 15 pM library for loading
steps.instruction: Calculate the volume needed for 15 pM in 600 µL: (15 pM × 600 µL)/2133.44 pM = 4.22 µL; add 4.22 µL of PAL to 595.78 µL HT buffer.

steps.title: Denature and heat library
steps.instruction: Thaw PAL at room temperature, pipette up/down 5 times, brief centrifuge; combine with HT buffer, vortex at top speed, brief centrifuge, then incubate 2 min at 96 °C ± 2 °C.

steps.title: Cool library and run MiSeq wash
steps.instruction: Transfer the denatured library to ice for at least 5 min; run a short wash cycle on the Illumina MiSeq sequencer to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Prepare MiSeq reagent cartridge
steps.instruction: Thaw the MiSeq reagent cartridge at room temperature.

steps.title: Generate MiSeq sample sheet
steps.instruction: Use Illumina Experiment Manager to create a sample sheet (FASTQ Only workflow, NexteraXT assay, 151 bp reads, unique sample IDs and index‑pair combinations).

steps.title: Rinse flow cell
steps.instruction: Rinse the flow cell with MilliQ water, remove residual water with soft tissue paper, and install it in the instrument.

steps.title: Load library onto cartridge
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire 600 µL diluted library into the “Load here” well of the MiSeq reagent cartridge.

steps.title: Start MiSeq sequencing run
steps.instruction: Insert the cartridge into the MiSeq instrument and commence sequencing according to the configured run parameters.

steps.title: Import FASTQ files into Geneious
steps.instruction: In Geneious, go to File → Import → From File and import the raw‑read files (Sample_xx_R1.fastq.gz and Sample_xx_R2.fastq.gz).

steps.title: Download reference genome
steps.instruction: From NCBI, download the full sequence of Enterococcus faecium NC_017960 (use the Nucleotide database, click “Download Full Sequence(s)”).

steps.title: Import reference into Geneious
steps.instruction: Drag and drop the downloaded NC_017960 reference genome into the Geneious working folder.

steps.title: Map reads to reference
steps.instruction: Select both R1 and R2 raw‑read files and the reference genome, then choose Align → Assemble → Map to Reference; verify settings before running.

steps.title: Analyze mapping results
steps.instruction: After mapping, a new folder containing four files is created; downstream analyses (e.g., resistance gene detection, phylogeny) can be performed using tools such as TGS‑TB, PhyResSe, ResFinder, and VirulenceFinder.
